retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, grainy black-and-white portrait with a stark halftone texture and right-aligned serif typography.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist sans-serif layouts are requested
clean digital vector art is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast black-and-white portrait of a man with a beard and curly hair, characterized by heavy grain and a halftone-like texture. The subject is positioned on the left, looking directly at the viewer, while the right side features clean, stacked serif typography in dark blue and muted red.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame
Typography is anchored to the right vertical axis
Extreme contrast between deep blacks and blown-out whites
Heavy film grain texture across the entire image
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white tonal range
Visible halftone or heavy film grain texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up portrait occupying the left and center, scaled to fill the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the dark mass of the hair/beard.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's gaze on the left to the stacked text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Blown-out white space on the far right and top right corners.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark navy blue for primary display text
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted brick red for secondary subtitle text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with zero saturation in the image and low saturation in the text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classical Roman serif with high stroke contrast
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same typeface family with color and scale contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classical serif structure and high contrast.
Provides the elegant, vintage book-like quality of the original.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a man with a beard and curly hair, using a heavy halftone grain effect. The subject should be on the left, leaving white space on the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two levels of stacked, right-aligned serif text in the white space. The top level should be large and dark navy blue; the bottom level should be medium-sized and muted brick red.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white with high contrast?
Is the text right-aligned and stacked?
Are the colors for the text dark blue and muted red?

mustRedesign: Do not use modern digital filters that smooth the skin

avoid: Muddy grays in the high-contrast areas

postGenerationChecks: Verify right-alignment of all text blocks
Ensure grain texture is consistent across the subject
Confirm the two-color hierarchy in the typography
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W portrait + Halftone grain + Right-aligned stacked serif typography
